summary: The notebook currently holds two notes: a foundations course note on gradient descent and a structured reading of the Transformer paper, spanning machine-learning and deep-learning areas.

areas.label: Machine Learning
areas.coverage: One foundational course note covers gradient descent basics, learning-rate intuition, and a worked quadratic example.
areas.gap: Only the first lesson of the ml-foundations course is published; broader coverage of optimization and training fundamentals is implied but not yet present.

areas.label: Deep Learning
areas.coverage: A detailed reading note covers the Transformer architecture, scaled dot-product attention, multi-head attention, and WMT 2014 results.
areas.gap: No notes on subsequent Transformer-era advances such as sub-quadratic attention, positional encoding variants, or serving/inference topics mentioned as future directions.
